preFinalAssetSafetyNotes: Avoid Safari UI, URL bars, and browser controls in final assets.
Do not show email, token, private path, raw audio, Storage path, secret, magic link, or account identifier.
Do not show recording filenames, MIME / codec, file size, or other technical file metadata.
Avoid error states, loading-in-progress states, network failure states, and too-short warnings when possible.
Do not show unimplemented claims such as Brush-up v1.1 as a v1 feature.
Do not show misleading actual-deletion-complete wording.
